classification.I: Inherited fixed properties, calculated mean and 700 x 1600 mm top reservation
classification.A: Assumed local number-lognormal, widths, uniform dilute slip; unknown alpha

model.U: Qc/A nominal dilute velocity; no finite-holdup velocity correction
model.absoluteScaling: Qup=A*alpha*K_up; ppmv relative to continuous Qc = alpha*(K_up/U)*1e6, NOT total-dispersion denominator
model.mobility: Myint et al. 2006 DOI 10.1299/jfst.1.72 Eq.9 clean C/mu=0: CD=24/Re*(2+3lambda)/(3*(1+lambda))*(1+0.15Re^0.687). EXTRAPOLATION: lambda=0.02368 below tested 0.1; contributing Re and Eo also partly below tested ranges (0.17<Re<200, 0.017<Eo<12.1). Not validation or guaranteed bound. Correct creeping limit is HR, v/Stokes=3*(1+lambda)/(2+3lambda).
model.sn: Inherited isolated spherical immobile-interface Schiller-Naumann model; base threshold unchanged; not physical validation
model.support: Physical assumed lognormal support (0,infinity), not donor detection bounds. Numerical z>=-16; upward support ends at exact vt=U root. Coarse local tail above root has zero upward weight, not a need to extrapolate its drag.
model.undefinedCases: If alpha=0 there is no physical upward flux; normalized kernel is only a conditional mathematical shape. If K_up=0 its normalized DSD, percentiles and d32 are undefined; all evaluated lognormal cases have K_up>0.

interpretation: s=.35/.44 are conditional donor-width transfers, not fitted RRBO widths or confidence limits; .70/1 are analyst broad stresses.

No capture efficiency assigned. Retain 700 reservation; neither certify nor reject it from these conditional tails.
